title: POST /api/client/location
description: REST twin (devices on the hub path only) of the WS location_report for reports without a hub socket (app in the background). Authorization: Bearer <device secret> (like /api/client/control); 401 for an unknown, revoked or deleted device. Answers: 200 location_report_ok, 403 location_report_error {location_not_allowed|location_background_not_allowed|not_hub_controlled}, 422 {invalid_request|location_stale}, 429 {rate_limited} with Retry-After (bodies = schemas/ws/server/location_report_*.json).

background.description: Fix taken while the app was not in the foreground.

location_shared.description: What the app shares now (optional, like client_status.location_shared).
